description: Distribution of consumers Kingdom-wide based on type of consumption and the quantities of their consumption* is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Saudi Arabia Distribution of consumers Kingdom-wide based on the type of consumption for 2006-2017. Data from Electricity and Cogeneration Regulatory Authority. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Based on Consumption and the quantity of their consumption NETC is an independent company, wholly owned by SEC. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Electricity Consumption, Energy Consumers. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
